# tests/fixtures/

Regression corpus for the lesson-capture Stop hook matcher.

## layer1-false-positives.jsonl

### Purpose

Real-transcript regression corpus for the lesson-capture matcher
(`.claude/hooks/lesson-capture-gate.cjs`). Every session in this fixture
fired the Layer 1 Stop hook with false-positive signals — none of them
contained actual operator corrections. The Layer 2 tightened matcher
must return **zero** Tier 1 (Strong) and **zero** Tier 2 (Medium)
signals on every section of this file.

### Scrubbing policy

- `cpeteconnor@gmail.com` → `[redacted-email]` (global string replace,
  6 occurrences scrubbed)
- **No other scrubbing applied.** A secrets scan in the Layer 2
  approval gate (tasks/todo.md 2026-04-09) confirmed the source
  transcripts contain no API keys, bearer tokens, AWS credentials,
  or other sensitive material. Home directory paths, session UUIDs,
  git commit hashes, and the public `noreply@anthropic.com`
  boilerplate from Co-Authored-By lines are intentionally preserved
  — they are non-sensitive and represent real session content the
  matcher needs to see.

### File shape

JSONL. Each section begins with one header record:

```json
{"_section":"<name>","source":"<uuid>.jsonl","span":"<HH:MM:SSZ-HH:MM:SSZ>"}
```

followed by records matching `parseTranscript`'s expected shape:

```json
{"type":"user"|"assistant","timestamp":"...","message":{"role":"...","content":"..."|[...]}}
```

Content may be a string (user turns) or an array of content blocks
(assistant turns) — preserved exactly as written to the source
transcript. Header records are silently skipped by `parseTranscript`
(they lack a recognized `type` field).

### Expected matcher behavior

The Layer 2 tightened matcher must return:

- **0 Tier 1 (Strong) signals** on every section
- **0 Tier 2 (Medium) signals** on every section

Sections 2 and 3 (`first-prime-patterns-boot`,
`second-prime-patterns-boot`) should additionally be fully suppressed
by the Tier 3 boot-exclusion rule regardless of content.

### Regeneration

**Do not edit this file manually.** Regenerate with:

```bash
node scripts/build-layer1-fixture.cjs
```

The extractor script lives at `scripts/build-layer1-fixture.cjs`.
It is gitignored (see `.gitignore` "Layer 2 fixture tooling" section)
but kept on disk for on-demand regeneration. If the working copy is
lost, reconstruct it from the spec in `tasks/todo.md` "Approval gate —
SIGNED OFF 2026-04-09".
